## Description and Rationale

I am a rising junior majoring in Computer Science, and I decided to take on the PRC Challenge as a solo participant. I wanted to step outside the classroom and apply the data analytics skills I have learned to a real-life problem. More importantly, I see this challenge as an opportunity to strengthen my ability to work with real-world data, explore meaningful insights, and develop practical solutions. I am excited to challenge myself, learn from the experience, and see how far I can take my skills through an independent project.

## Details

* Type: Independent
* Country: Vietnam
* Number of team members: 1
